purpose: Public engineering mechanism check, not a confirmatory trial or new game certification
model: unchanged gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14, temperature 0, JSON object, 10000 input/2500 output tokens, timeout 60s, retries 0
scope_first_prompt: First determine whether ONE static visibility partition can represent ALL modeled decision times. Then output exactly ONE of the two alternative JSON envelopes below. If representable, output the candidate envelope with 1 to 3 distinct partitions and assign every declared field exactly once in each candidate. If not representable because the SAME field changes visibility for a player, output only the refusal envelope with a valid change witness. Never output both envelopes, put candidates in a refusal, or force a static fit. Do not split, rename or add fields. Candidate envelope: {schema_version:aip-observation-gamespec-candidates-v1,game_id:CASE_ID,candidates:[{hypothesis_id:ID,public_fields:[],private_fields_by_player:{player_0:[],player_1:[]}}]}. Refusal envelope: {schema_version:aip-observation-refusal-v1,game_id:CASE_ID,status:out_of_schema,error_code:OUT_OF_SCHEMA_STATIC_VISIBILITY,witness:{field:FIELD,player:INTEGER_0_OR_1,before_visible:BOOLEAN,after_visible:BOOLEAN}}. The two witness booleans must describe a real change of visibility across modeled times. Output JSON only, use lowercase hypothesis identifiers, and never invent prior, evidence, reliability or certification.
witness_gloss_prompt: Feedback witness semantics: left_fields and right_fields are TWO COUNTERFACTUAL WORLDS at the SAME modeled decision time, not earlier and later states. observed_same says whether the acting player's legal observation is equal in those worlds; it does not say all field values are equal. A field value changing across these worlds does NOT mean its visibility changes over time. Temporal visibility changes must come from the RULES, not from left/right ordering.

pairs.dynamic_rules: Two dice are rolled. Before the first modeled decision each player sees only their own die and the public history. Both dice are publicly revealed after that decision and before subsequent modeled decisions. Thus player 1 cannot see die_0 at the first modeled decision but can see it at later modeled decisions. Both phases must be represented under the same field names without splitting or renaming die_0.

A prize is public. At the first modeled response decision player 0 has secretly submitted a bid and knows it, and player 1 cannot see that commitment before responding. Player 1 alone sees their own hand and player 0 cannot see that hand. Before a later modeled response decision the same commitment is publicly revealed, so player 1 then sees it. The hand remains private to player 1. Both phases must be represented under the same field names without splitting or renaming commitment.

Both players see an announcement. At the first modeled decision only player 1 sees both a signal and its retained private record; player 0 sees neither. Before a later modeled decision the same signal is publicly revealed, so player 0 then sees that signal. The retained record remains private to player 1 throughout. Both phases must be represented under the same field names without splitting or renaming signal.

schedule.arm_rotation: rotate arm list left by (case_index + repeat) modulo 4, separately per task
schedule.scope_task: same eight paired rules, no feedback, exactly one reply
schedule.witness_task: four static rules only; same fixed two incorrect initial partitions as v2; STRUCTURE_OK plus same two preselected witnesses in every arm; exactly one repair reply, no further repair
schedule.budget_interpretation: identical one-reply opportunity and token cap per condition, not equal realized token use; differs from v2 adaptive repair schedule so historical comparison is descriptive

evaluation.unit: four rule pairs; repeats are technical repeats, not additional independent game families
evaluation.primary_scope: per pair/repeat/arm joint success: static candidate independently verifies reference AND dynamic rule strictly refused with exact registered witness
evaluation.primary_witness: per static rule/arm correct reference verified after one fixed semantic-feedback reply; also report erroneous refusal
evaluation.contrasts: A effect within each B level on pair success; B effect within each A level on witness repair; report all four cells and paired differences, no pooled claim of significance
evaluation.uncertainty: all pair-level and repeat outcomes; no population CI or power claim from four public pairs
evaluation.refusal: reuse unchanged strict v1 refusal validator for EACH explicitly registered valid change; either of the two true changes is accepted in delayed-public-dice pair p2; player is integer not string, float or bool
evaluation.in_scope: reuse v2 candidate compiler and final six field contrasts; feedback worlds 2/3 and final worlds 0/1 remain separate
evaluation.oos_false_acceptance: report static-candidate replies separately even if structurally valid; do not hide these behind zero in-scope false certifications
evaluation.partial_run: retain incomplete assigned trials; never silently drop, retry or replace
evaluation.authority: reference, source reliability and final evidence remain evaluator-owned; no expected branch or reference in requests

resource_protection.role: anomaly stop only, never evidence of effectiveness

progression: inspect every failure; only after feedback exposure and executability are established separately preregister a meaningful semantic-versus-structural repair experiment and effect-size/sample-size design
